scope_note: Slice 4 (2026-08-19-slice-04-tenant-setup). Section A (VER-DOH-001..VER-DOH-0XX, one per commit with a quantified claim) is mined mechanically from every commit body between df5455b and HEAD that states a typecheck/unit/component/release/build result — 32 commits total, of which the ones with quantified claims are listed. Section B is hand-curated from the small number of report sections that quote an exact command, its exit code, and/or a timestamp: infra-fixes-report.md's three-run and concurrency-trial evidence (the same evidence this build's own controller cites as the resolution of a public retraction, progress.md:1178-1222), task-9-report.md's command block, and task-2-review.md's command block. Every row's exact_command, exit_code and timestamp fields are 'unrecorded' individually wherever the source artifact does not state that specific fact — most commit messages give counts without commands or exit codes; most report command blocks give commands and counts without exit codes or timestamps; only the infra-fixes-report.md round-3 addendum gives all three at once, which is exactly the property that settled the retraction. APPENDED 2026-08-25 BY FIX STREAM S (round-6 finding C-00 residual): this ledger was frozen at slice 4 and slice 11 reached round 6 of its audit loop with no entry here at all. Two slice-11 verification RECORDS exist as prose under docs/process/, at candidates c6ae6df and eb75092, and both predate rounds 3 to 6. VER-S11-039 is the first slice-11 row in this ledger and the first verification of any round after round 2. It is bound to a Candidate ID that docs/process/ledgers/product-candidate-manifest.json derives from the candidate's own bytes, so the binding master prompt §29.4 requires can be checked rather than asserted.
